analysis.purpose: Appends an RDP blend-color command containing four float channels scaled by 255 and packed into RGBA bytes. The intended input range is uncertain.
analysis.observed_abi: Reads a0 as an owner pointer and a1 as four consecutive f32 values. Leaf with a 0x10-byte stack frame. C uses void; assembly leaves the object pointer in v0, so the original return type remains uncertain.
evidence: Original assembly contains one complete 172-instruction function and no outgoing calls or imports.
Expected bytes differ from game_libs_func_000470E4 and game_libs_func_00047394 only at offset 0x254, the command constant.
Grouping channel loads inside the first conversion resolves the remaining constant-load scheduling difference.
Reused existing GL470E4 shared layouts; removed the independent BlendColor types.
Inspected family: game_libs_func_000470E4, game_libs_func_00047394, gl_func_00046FA8, gl_func_00047644, gl_func_000476DC, game_libs_func_0004CDB0 and caller gl_func_000546BC.
Observed chain: owner+0x254 -> context+0x158 -> object+0xC -> list; list+0 holds packet storage and list+4 holds the incremented count. Packets occupy eight bytes.
Recovered caller gl_func_000546BC targets game_libs_func_00047B28 at bootup Text 0x68D3C, equivalent to game_libs offset 0x546D0.
Both compiled C bodies match the immutable expected function bytes; objdiff reports 100%.
Regression comparison preserved 842 previously exact normal functions and 548 previously exact NON_MATCHING functions in this unit.
make -j2 verify verify-blocks passed, including byte-identical ROM comparison.

Fresh upstream port: original compiler in both modes, complete native call/data USO identity checks, exact source-generated tables/constants, exact host function bytes, full ROM and all six strict original code-block payloads.
hypotheses: The input represents normalized RGBA components.
unknowns: Original return type and complete object-class identities are not established.
The caller's existing collapsed C aliases do not establish its relocated argument identities; that body was left unchanged.
Call-graph coverage generally excludes unrecovered relocation and indirect edges; this function's assembly independently confirms it has no calls.

The surrounding host definition preserves compiler/RoData context; the required independently compiled C implementation is src/match_imports/game_libs_func_00047B28.c. This is not a proof of original source spelling or whole-program portable source.

limitations: Indirect calls and missing recovered relocations stay unresolved; alias value zero is not an identity.
Observed indirect calls prove possible executed targets only; preserve indirect C dispatch and other unknown runtime targets.
